facts.fact: Eswatini hosts 5 058 registered refugees and asylum seekers, and the Ministry of Home Affairs dispatched 70 refugee status permits and 77 machine-readable Convention Travel Documents in April-June 2026.
The Ministry of Home Affairs says refugee status permits let holders obtain personal identification numbers, national identity cards and access to government and financial services.

facts.fact: The Central Bank and the Commissioner for Refugees have prepared a KYC information pack for asylum seekers and refugees and recommend issuing every refugee a permit or registration document to enter the national civil registry and receive a national personal identification number, which is not yet implemented.

The Central Bank of Eswatini and the Commissioner for Refugees recommend a permit or registration document for all refugees, to register them on the national civil registry and give them a national ID number; not yet implemented.
